correctness.rationale: For an outermost occupied subgroup H and its index-q successor U, every relevant radial indicator splits as 1_(H\U)+1_F with F⊆U. The q characters of H trivial on U have Fourier coefficients ((q−1)+μ)/q and (μ−1)/q, with μ=|F|/|U|; all remaining characters extend nontrivial characters of U in q-fold blocks. Absolute summation yields the exact one-step recursion ||E||_A=c_q+||F||_A−c_q μ, c_q=2(1−1/q). Nonempty proper F and its complement each have A-norm ≥1 by Fourier inversion, and ||F||_A−||U\F||_A=2μ−1, so ||F||_A≥max(1,2μ). For q≥3 this makes every non-shell, nonball norm strictly larger than c_q; one shell attains c_q. For q=2 the recurrence gives norm≥3/2 whenever F proper/nonempty, with equality forcing μ=1/2 and ||F||_A=1. Radial half-density forces exactly the next outer shell alone or the entire next subgroup, giving precisely two equality configurations. The identity 1_E=e0 1_G+Σ(ej−ej−1)1_Hj and annihilator-shell multiplicities (q−1)q^(s−1) prove the full rational norm formula for every depth. Finite exact rational pattern and direct DFT tests in the inspected checker corroborate, but the argument is all-depth. Small-norm and q=2 k=1 boundaries are consistent.
